## Items

Buy rare weapon items with the goal of maximising weapon power. But keep [Armored Vest](item_358361e2-59be-4c81-b221-8a87f37809e6).

Make sure to have at least 5 items, preferably 6.

### Required

- [Armored Vest](item_358361e2-59be-4c81-b221-8a87f37809e6)

   - This will be your only survival item for now.

### Optional

Build for weapon power:

- [Custom Stock](item_17d633af-8bcc-4893-b865-be0a7bc66fe2)

   - Really good value for money, also benefits ability power, the only reason you don't pick this up is if you have a lot of cash.

- [Talon Modification Module](item_c0ca1795-a3ea-4dc9-ae17-f34122574b3a)

   - Most expensive but highest value, don't get this if you cannot fill all 6 slots.

- [Icy Coolant](item_8b1c21e9-33e8-49a6-8277-a3a06d55a65f)

   - Really good alternative to [Talon Modification Module](item_c0ca1795-a3ea-4dc9-ae17-f34122574b3a).

- [Shieldbuster](item_9ee1f150-537d-40b9-b975-7820fb1c6a66)

   - If the enemy has armour, get this.

- [Emergency Chip](item_c73e060f-94df-4e6b-bb6d-fe2f65e31dd1)

   - Not as good this season since it was nerfed, still decent so don't ignore it.

#### Extra cash

1. [Compensator](item_2a354f80-610c-4661-9bdd-8960ae1a60b0)

   - Get this to further increases potential cash generation.

2. [Ammo Reserves](item_982d53aa-5ef4-493f-93e7-9e374d0ebf34)

   -  This item is good for a more spammy playstyle.

3. [Power Playbook](item_6d8803cf-baa7-46ee-af91-51e7f2301418)

   - If you can't afford [Ammo Reserves](item_982d53aa-5ef4-493f-93e7-9e374d0ebf34), get this.

## Power

Get either[Slapnel](item_960e424b-3533-46b1-8063-11b575225647) or [Bingo!](item_1234b16b-1426-4a0c-b6c3-213180336cc6) depending on what you picked  in round 3:

You now have 4 ability charges to trigger [Lumerico Fusion Drive](item_3da81000-333c-460a-a1a2-09441bfda9c8) with, and you recharge then exceptionally fast with [Bingo!](item_1234b16b-1426-4a0c-b6c3-213180336cc6).

## Items

### Required

- [Lumerico Fusion Drive](item_3da81000-333c-460a-a1a2-09441bfda9c8)

   - Remember that you need to be hitting [Bingo!](item_1234b16b-1426-4a0c-b6c3-213180336cc6) shots to be able to take full advantage of this, farm abilities off the tank.

- [Phantasmic Flux](item_5e644a79-cf6e-4196-8d0a-232f75004643)

   - With this, you can build up a nice buffer of overhealth, then using it to play more aggressively. Then run away back into cover and repeat.

- [Vanadium Injection](item_57953fbc-11ff-4e92-9928-fc59b7be668f)

   - By now your ultimate is basically useless, the enemy will have enough utility to destroy it or avoid the damage all together.

   - If you are horrendously broke, you can skip this until next round to afford some good rare items.

### Optional

If you have enough cash, get [Superflexor](item_580b77b4-0d63-469b-99a8-5372c55dfc1b), all 5 stacks of this will get activated by [Bango!](item_b48a6731-fae8-4732-aae0-ceffbf324235) giving you are free +25% AP.

If you are filthy rich and have tons of cash after getting [Superflexor](item_580b77b4-0d63-469b-99a8-5372c55dfc1b):

- [Martian Mender](item_0099632b-4e18-450e-844f-22c40e51bc98), the passive healing will allow you to play much more aggressively and away from your supports and the cooldown reduction is also really good.

- [Eye of the Spider](item_bbaf01d7-340d-4199-b738-86a98d68fe9b), massive damage output increase.

With your remaining cash, continue to build for weapon power:

   - Really good value for money, also benefits ability power, the only reason you don't pick this up is if you have a lot of cash.

   - Most expensive but highest value, don't get this if you cannot fill all 6 slots.

- [Icy Coolant](item_8b1c21e9-33e8-49a6-8277-a3a06d55a65f)

   - Really good alternative to [Talon Modification Module](item_c0ca1795-a3ea-4dc9-ae17-f34122574b3a).

- [Shieldbuster](item_9ee1f150-537d-40b9-b975-7820fb1c6a66)

   - If the enemy has armour, get this.

- [Emergency Chip](item_c73e060f-94df-4e6b-bb6d-fe2f65e31dd1)

   - Not as good this season since it was nerfed, still decent so don't ignore it.

#### Extra cash

   - Get this to further increases potential cash generation.

2. [Ammo Reserves](item_982d53aa-5ef4-493f-93e7-9e374d0ebf34)

   -  This item is good for a more spammy playstyle.

3. [Power Playbook](item_6d8803cf-baa7-46ee-af91-51e7f2301418)

## Power

I recommend [Frags For Days](item_bc48152f-c523-4dc7-afe0-1c016906bc8a) since the bonus grenade will also trigger [Bingo!](item_1234b16b-1426-4a0c-b6c3-213180336cc6), [Bango!](item_b48a6731-fae8-4732-aae0-ceffbf324235), and by extension, [Superflexor](item_580b77b4-0d63-469b-99a8-5372c55dfc1b).

You could instead get [Double Trouble](item_850f4701-cb41-4083-ba0e-7f96b6757025) for another ability charge, but focusing on primary fire is preferred.

## Items

### Required

- [Lumerico Fusion Drive](item_3da81000-333c-460a-a1a2-09441bfda9c8)

- [Hardlight Accelerator](item_0390c8af-2a68-4da2-b876-93da32c3f448)

   - Has the same cooldown reduction but also gives weapon power.

- [Cybervenom](item_210a8582-91ec-4cf3-968a-a443f3a0c505)

   - Good against a team with high healing numbers.

- [Liquid Nitrogen](item_a8d99526-05a3-4405-babb-b025479b1b98)

- [Three-tap Tommygun](item_39c5d2a4-1db0-444f-86d9-2a1e9a331429)

   - Higher damage against high health targets.

- [Mark of the Kitsune](item_09a53e39-25aa-4f66-ba51-bedbc543a1eb)
